gates.title: Proposal Completeness
blockers: Language/layout, product support targets and named package ownership remain unselected.

gates.title: Evidence Integrity And Comparability
blockers: Full equivalent semantics/diagnostics, all 84 comparable metrics and two independent scores/reconciliation are missing.

gates.title: Candidate Eligibility
blockers: All four unchanged assessor outcomes are ineligible; failed fidelity and target stages cannot be waived.

gates.title: Architecture And Dependency Direction
blockers: Concrete selected import/startup/API/version boundary implementations and tests are absent.

gates.title: CLI And Runtime Separation
blockers: Full installed static-command effect budgets and target-native credential/process/extension denial are not established.

gates.title: Security And Authority Boundaries
blockers: Partial isolation, dated advisories, native/runtime/license closure, resource/redaction/revocation/race evidence remain blockers.

gates.title: Extension And Provider Boundaries
blockers: Catalog/isolation/mediation/fallback mechanism choices and negative invocation tests are absent.

gates.title: Event, Audit, And State Boundaries
blockers: Concrete stores, ownership, retention/access/integrity/recovery/durability and crash/export tests are missing.

gates.title: Packaging, Distribution, And Operations
blockers: Native lifecycle failures/drift, previous artifacts/upgrade/rollback/signing, dependency closure and accepted support obligations remain unresolved.

gates.title: Conformance, Compatibility, And Migration
blockers: Supported pair matrix, fixture owners and complete migration/rollback/conformance evidence are not accepted.

gates.title: Rationale, Governance, And Ownership
blockers: No defensible selection, actual independent review/reconciliation, dissent record or named maintainer consent exists.

acceptance.rule: Every mandatory gate passed, all blockers closed at one exact reviewed RFC/evidence revision, two independent reviews and maintainer consent through governance. Merge or CI cannot waive this.

limitations: Preparation only; no new candidate execution, vulnerability refresh, benchmark, repair, runtime or product support claim.
All failed/partial/unsupported/not-tested inputs remain visible; missing metrics are not zero-valued observations.
Historical NF-066/NF-067 are framework preparation, not current architecture acceptance.
A later human record must pin the published RFC/report assembly commits and hashes; null revisions/signatures are unfilled, not approvals.
NF-101 appointments/owner/signing consent, NF-102 independent decision review and NF-103 readiness remain separate.
